sahneler.metin: Seconds after lift-off, a cargo rocket exploded over Virginia.
It fell back onto the launch pad in a fireball.
Nobody was aboard; it carried supplies for the space station.
Its engines were refurbished engines built decades earlier.
A turbopump in one of them failed.
With thrust lost, the rocket was destroyed.
Antares was later rebuilt with new engines.

aciklama:
Orb-3 exploded seconds after lift-off. The cause: failure in the liquid oxygen turbopump of a refurbished AJ26 engine.
